text:
Ava: Quick sync — we're scheduling canary r2003 tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PT. Need deploy-bot change-window handshake + 2 approvers. Anyone object to the traffic contract: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 30m with 10m holdpoints? Also need telemetry dashboard updated for split tags.
Diego: Sounds ok. Should we add a backpressure guard at 50% latency p95 > 350ms? :thinking_face:
Priya: +1 on guard. Also quota check: dedicated pool has burst headroom ~18k qps, will that cover 60%? @deploy-bot can you confirm?
deploy-bot: queued approval request r2003. Required approvers: 2. Change window: 2026-03-21T09:00:00-07:00 to 10:30:00-07:00. Reply 'approve r2003' to accept.
Jon: Need list of evaluation prompts for quality regression. Add eval-suite 'conversational-regression-v2' to rollout notes.
Ava: Will attach eval link and dashboard panels. Also propose traffic label: 'canary=r2003,split=alpha' so rolling telemetry splits nicely.
SRE-Bot: Alerting checklist: p95 latency, error rate, model fallback rate, throttling events. Set auto-fallback to previous variant at >3% errors or sustained p95 > 400ms for 3 minutes.
Diego: For staging rehearsal — use this split config snippet:
```json
{"stages":[{"pct":5,"duration_mins":10},{"pct":25,"duration_mins":10},{"pct":60,"duration_mins":10}],"guards":{"latency_p95_ms":350,"error_pct":1.5}}
```
Priya: small nit — deploy-bot needs to expose manual 'hold' action for QA during holdpoints. Ops wants manual override without aborting rollout.
Ava: Agreed. Add a canary action 'pause' that sends a DM to approvers and sets traffic to last stable split.
Jon: Approved from eng-safety, will review dashboard panels before handoff.
Diego: I approve r2003
Priya: approve r2003
deploy-bot: approval received (2). Scheduling rollout in change window. Next: CI smoke + canary rehearsal at 08:15 PT tomorrow. :rocket:
Ava: Thanks all. I'll update the release ticket with links and add the eval set.
